entities.name: Turi
entities.description: Kiora's merfolk sister who refused to join Gideon's forces at Sea Gate and followed Yenai.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: Planeswalker and Turi's sister whose spark ignited when a sea serpent swallowed her.

entities.name: Yenai
entities.description: Old merfolk loremaster who led a remnant to Murasa.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Eldrazi titan headed for Sea Gate.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: Trickster god of whom Kiora told stories.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: Port that fell to the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: War during which Sea Gate fell.

events.summary: A sea serpent attacks Turi and Kiora; Kiora seems eaten, which ignites her spark.
events.quote: this event triggered Kiora's spark, sending her away from inside the serpent's mouth to another plane

events.summary: Kiora returns and promises to always return if Turi promises to wait.
events.quote: Kiora promised to always return if Turi always promised to wait for her.

events.summary: Sea Gate falls to the Eldrazi and Turi joins Yenai's merfolk heading to Murasa.
events.quote: When it fell, Turi joined the old loremaster Yenai

events.summary: Kiora joins them and tries to convince them to go back to Sea Gate; Turi and Yenai refuse.
events.quote: Turi and Yenai had had enough devastation and death and denied Kiora their aid.

events.summary: Kiora antagonizes Yenai, takes her recruits, appoints a woman to look after Turi and swims off.

relations.quote: Turi joined the old loremaster Yenai
